facts.fact: Winter 自拒绝 mate Talia 后一直逛妓院
facts.anchor: Winter had been visiting the brothels ever since he rejected his mate, Talia

facts.fact: 八年前那个人类女孩是他唯一动心过的人，直到发现她的叛徒血统
facts.anchor: the only one he’d ever found himself drawn to until he discovered the traitorous blood running through her veins
he would die alone with no heir to the throne

facts.fact: 猎人两小时前（天亮前）袭击
facts.anchor: Hunters attacked two hours ago while it was still dark

facts.fact: 国王杀了两名袭击者，但断了手臂和腿、几乎被开膛
facts.anchor: He managed to kill two of the attackers, but not before they broke his arm, leg, and nearly disemboweled him

facts.fact: 第三名袭击者被关在牢里
facts.anchor: Just one more, and he’s locked in a cell

facts.fact: 国王四十七岁，此时显得更老
facts.anchor: he looked older than his forty-seven years

facts.fact: 国王命 Winter 代行统治、自证能力
facts.anchor: You’ll rule in my stead until I’m well again. Prove yourself

facts.fact: Winter 盘算往药里掺乌头
facts.anchor: perhaps Winter could slip wolfsbane into one of the concoctions

facts.fact: 结尾：若父亲活下来，他会让他后悔
facts.anchor: And if his father lived, he would make him regret it
